description: This Java class 'PersistenceStatusStage' is part of an Akka-based stream processing system within the Eclipse Ditto project. It creates a specialized processing stage that manages the retrieval of persistence metrics by publishing health check requests, aggregating responses, and determining whether all expected responses were received within a timeout, ultimately emitting either the aggregated status information or a credit decision indicating failure.

classes.name: PersistenceStatusStage
classes.description: A utility class that provides a factory method to create an Akka Stream graph stage which manages querying persistence health metrics and aggregating responses.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates an Akka Stream graph stage that manages sending health check messages to a pub/sub mediator, awaiting responses, and emitting either aggregated status info or a credit decision based on response completeness.

methods.name: askAggregator
methods.description: Internal method that creates a message aggregator actor, publishes a health check request, and returns a future for the aggregation result.

methods.name: askAggregatorFlow
methods.description: Internal method that builds a flow transforming input integers (expected number of responses) into pairs of the expected count and the aggregation reply via asynchronous ask pattern.

methods.name: checkAggregatorReply
methods.description: Evaluates the aggregated responses to determine if all expected status info replies were received, returning either a positive or negative credit decision.

methods.name: safeCastAsStatusInfoList
methods.description: Utility method to safely cast the reply object into a list of StatusInfo objects if possible.
